svg.title: Slingshot — a supernova level
svg.desc: Planning mockup (WP12): the system's star is an unstable red supergiant with its supernova countdown and lethal blast radius; a quasar's jet sweeps across the top; a stray asteroid drifts across; chips say when the path clears the blast zone.

g.text: path leaves the blast zone at 0:41 · 0:07 to spare
